title: Duplicate-goal check can report 'no goal' from an incomplete search
current: Goal discovery fails closed on errors, but can still return no candidates without an error when the existing goal is beyond the 100-post author search, not yet indexed by Reddit search, or unclassifiable. Onboarding then creates a duplicate goal.
evidence: searchForGoalPosts uses limit onboardingAuthorSearchLimit = 100. Errors throw (lines ~376, ~412). #225 shows real goal posts whose post data can't be read.
investigate: Does a known source (registered, tracked, queued, persisted, highlighted) always cover a goal the search misses?
Test: the goal exists only beyond 100 search results; the goal was created seconds ago.

criticality.why: A duplicate goal post is moderator-visible and confusing for subscribers.
